overall: The AG found the Malden School Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the executive session notice topics, including the Purpose 7 minutes review and the Purpose 2 superintendent salary item, were sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 6 notice's first three executive session topics (review of May 6, 16, and 29 minutes, Purpose 7) lacked specificity because they did not name court cases or matters.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice for the Superintendent's salary topic (Purpose 2) was insufficiently specific because it did not state the committee would discuss a cost of living adjustment.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the description of the matter to be discussed was adequate, as it identified the employee to be discussed and, moreover, informed the public that the Committee would review her salary for the 2023-2024 term.
